definitions.explanation: An abbreviation of {冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}. Pre-prepared food that is frozen for preservation and convenience.

examples.japanese: {冷食|れいしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ストック→ストック：11580_sutokku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おく。
examples.english: To keep frozen food stocked up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冷食|れいしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Frozen food nowadays is really delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷食|れいしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦レンジ→レンジ：01047_renji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{温|あたた}めて→温める：02096_atatameru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: On busy days, I often heat up frozen food in the microwave.

notes:
{冷食|れいしょく} is an abbreviation of ⟦{冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}→冷凍食品：06075_reitoushokuhin⟧ (frozen food products). It is composed of {冷|れい} (cold, frozen) + {食|しょく} (food).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷食|れいしょく}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧: frozen food section (in a store)
- {冷食|れいしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}める→温める：02096_atatameru⟧: to heat up frozen food
- {冷食|れいしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品揃|しなぞろ}え→品揃え：11844_shinazoroe⟧: frozen food selection

USAGE: A casual, everyday abbreviation. The full form ⟦{冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}→冷凍食品：06075_reitoushokuhin⟧ is used in more formal contexts such as product labeling and news reports. Japanese frozen food quality is notably high, and the category includes items like ⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧, fried rice, and bento items.
